name: godot-rs
description: Pure Rust port and fork of the Godot Engine architecture: Core Variant system, SceneTree, Node hierarchy, 2D/3D Math, Servers, and .tscn parser

scripts.prepublishOnly: cargo build --release --bin godot && strip -x target/release/godot && cp target/release/godot bin/godot-bin

author: Brandon Hubbard
